subject: QUEUED BACKLOG: FLASH-3 — 32 NFL Stadium GeoCoordinates & Turf Friction Matrix
body:
Flash: Queued pipeline task (to begin immediately following FLASH-2).

Objective: Complete physical stadium metadata in packages/data-ingestion/src/source-atlas-harvester.ts.
1. Populate exact GPS coordinates, altitude (meters), timezone offset from UTC, roof type (RETRACTABLE, DOME, OPEN_AIR), and turf surface (FieldTurf, Bermuda grass, Matrix Turf) for all 32 NFL stadiums.
2. Link these into evaluateCircadianTravelFatigue and evaluateLinearWindPassImpact.
3. Verify with unit tests in packages/data-ingestion/src/__tests__/source-atlas-harvester.test.ts.
